description:
30,000+ dog and cat foods, scored instantly.

Scan the barcode. See what's really in it — before your pet eats it.

◆ 30,000 FOODS, BUILT IN ◆

Thirty thousand popular dog and cat foods ship inside the app. Most scans return the moment the barcode lands — no lookup, no waiting, and no connection needed. The catalog works in the aisle, in the basement, and on a plane.

Not in it? Photograph the ingredient panel and get the same analysis.

◆ HOW A FOOD GETS ITS SCORE ◆

Every ingredient on the label is read and rated: what it is, why it's in the food, and what to watch for. Each product gets a safety score that applies to any pet, and a suitability score for yours — a food can be fine in general and wrong for your dog.

Add a profile with your pet's allergens and PetScans names the conflict instead of leaving you to spot it. "Wheat flour is the first ingredient, and wheat is listed in Luna's allergen profile" is the kind of sentence you get back.

◆ NO BRAND PAYS US ◆

No sponsored scores. No affiliate links to the foods we rate. No manufacturer can move a rating, because none of them are paying for anything. The score you see is the score everyone sees.

◆ WHERE THE DATA COMES FROM ◆

Ingredient safety is sourced from AAFCO feed standards, FDA pet food regulation, ASPCA Animal Poison Control, the Merck Veterinary Manual, and peer-reviewed research. Warnings cite the source behind them.

PetScans provides educational information only and is not a substitute for professional veterinary advice.

Terms of service: https://petscans.app/terms
promotionalText: Allergen warnings no longer double up when a label spells one ingredient two ways. Plus one consistent look across every screen, and a friendlier setup.
whatsNew:
A quicker first check.

• Setup now opens with three popular foods for your dog or cat. Pick one and see it scored straight away, with nothing to type and no empty results.

• Checking your own food starts once setup is done, from the first tab: scan the barcode or search by name.
